description: This file defines a React component named EnhancedExecutionHeader, which displays detailed information about a workflow execution, including status, timeline, IDs, related workflow, and VC status. It also contains internal subcomponents such as ExecutionTimeline and HealthIndicator for visualizing execution progress and health.

methods.name: ExecutionTimeline
methods.description: A React component that visualizes the execution timeline with status icons and timestamps.

methods.name: HealthIndicator
methods.description: A React component that displays the health status of an execution based on its properties.

methods.name: truncateId
methods.description: A utility function that truncates IDs for display purposes.
